//InstanceDir: The Torch root's own Instance\Factions -- the folder holding tuning.json and the bridge. This is the ONLY directory the dashboard is configured with. Where state actually lives (brains, index, events, caches) is read from that tuning.json's DataDirectory key, exactly as the plugin resolves it, so the dashboard follows whatever server it is pointed at instead of being told twice and drifting.
//DataDir: Legacy alias for InstanceDir, kept because build.ps1 writes the service command line as '--data-dir <root>\Instance\Factions'. Read only when InstanceDir is unset. It has never named the shared data folder and must not be pointed at one.
